tools.name: search_entries
tools.description: Search the public SwiftSkills catalog. query is a case-insensitive substring (max 200 characters). category is an optional category slug. type is an optional kind: skill, mcp, rules, docs, or sdk. Returns name, slug, type, category, summary, and url. Every url includes utm_source=mcp and utm_medium=

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Fetch one public catalog entry by slug. Includes source_url, the install command, copied_at when the catalog recorded the day the command was copied, compatible tools, license when known, and the day the entry was added. URLs include utm_source=mcp and utm_medium=tool.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List catalog categories with slug, name, and url. The url includes utm_source=mcp and utm_medium=tool.

tools.name: list_new
tools.description: List entries added within the last days (default 7, maximum 90), newest first. Each row has name, slug, type, category, summary, url, and added. The url includes utm_source=mcp and utm_medium=tool.
